title: How Doing the Job's Ugliest Task First Changes a Godly Man's Whole Week
caption:
Every week has one task you're avoiding. The call you don't want to make, the invoice you keep re-reading instead of sending. You already know what it is.

Do it before the coffee's cold, not at 4 PM negotiating with your own exhaustion. Colossians 3:23 doesn't say work heartily at the parts that flatter you. It says whatever you do.

A man who does the hard thing first stops negotiating with himself by Wednesday. Start where you don't want to. Everything after gets lighter.
